prism-auto-config-map 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides a full workflow for generating advanced HTML reports supporting automotive configuration analysis, planning, and benchmarking using integrated official parameters and Patsnap patent/literature/supply chain data.
- Implements strict evidence, methodology, and data-freshness rules; supports QFD/质量屋, Matrix Analysis, Benchmarking, and related theoretical tags for each key conclusion.
- Outputs include a hero summary, data focus, methodology, product domain tech map, competitor pool, config penetration heatmap, QFD/matrix boards, patent/literature dashboards, OEM-supplier evidence, lifecycle × pricing strategy, and next-gen recommendations.
- Enforces detailed patent pool and supply chain evidence requirements, with scalable multi-page and asset-stable HTML export for demo and real-world delivery use.
- Includes comprehensive section and visual rules, strict reference loading, and robust quality checks for report completeness and offline portability.
